rows.grounds: optative/imperative of kṛ; prescribes the action to perform
fused sandhi compound; height equal to the Viṣṇu portion

items.question: How should the height of the liṅga be set relative to the Viṣṇu portion?
premises: The operation is to make something.
Its height equals the Viṣṇu portion.
items.inference: Therefore the liṅga height should match the Viṣṇu portion universally.
uncertainties: The exact object being made is not explicit in this verse.
items.plain_english: But one should indeed make it equal in height to the Viṣṇu portion in all ways.
